name: Typeform leads into HubSpot and email segments

parameters.content:
## What you told me, in plain English

1. People fill out your Typeform
2. Those leads are not landing in your HubSpot CRM properly
3. You want them in the first stage of your pipeline
4. That first stage kicks off the email segments you set up
5. You do not have the time to wire it yourself
6. More custom work may follow from here

## To go live, we wire

- Your Typeform account and the form id, one credential and one dropdown in the first node
- A HubSpot private app token with contacts, deals and lists rights, that is the only key I need
- Your pipeline name and the list each email segment runs off, so people start on the right one
